Scoring & data

Each revealed pick contributes its role-specific normalized matchup or synergy delta. Effects are adjusted by games ÷ (games + 1,000), then added. Unknown slots contribute nothing. Candidates with missing pair data are left unranked. “Include base WR” adds the candidate's overall win rate above 50%.

This score ranks draft fit. Adding pair effects has not been validated as a prediction of game win probability. Pair samples overlap, and the fixed sample adjustment is a conservative setting rather than a fitted model.

Blindability is a role-relative consistency score from 0 to 100, with higher scores indicating less variation across enemy and teammate matchups. It is independent of the current draft and does not affect draft edge. Hover its number for role-specific matchup or synergy spreads. Portraits show observed normalized WR deltas; the white curve approximates the noise-corrected spread.
